context_requirements: Expression of PKC-alpha (PRKCA) or related diacylglycerol/phorbol-ester-responsive PKC isoforms
Intact downstream MAPK/ERK and NF-kB signaling modules
Presence of AP-1 and NF-kB responsive promoters for immediate-early gene induction
falsifiers: No consistent induction of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1, DUSP6) at 6 h in any line
No suppression of proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h in any line
Responses that are equally strong in lines with very low versus high PRKCA expression
A pattern indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines at both time points

changes: Mechanism/target mismatch: PRKCA is a serine/threonine kinase, not a protein tyrosine kinase; primary_targets should be a tyrosine kinase or the mechanism should be changed.
Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from proximal lists: GADD45B, ATF5, BHLHE40, CEBPD, TSC22D3, SESN1, AXIN1, DUSP22.
Removed late generic proliferation genes from late_down: CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, MCM3, PCNA, E2F2, MYBL2, UBE2C, KIF20A.
Removed late generic matrix/inflammation genes from late_up: MMP1, MMP2, PTGS2, SERPINE1, TIMP2, ICAM1, CD44, SPP1, TGFB3, COL1A1, COL4A1, LAMA3, ITGB5, TRIB1, SQSTM1.
Corrected kinetics: a PTK activator would produce rapid, transient immediate-early induction, not sustained signaling.
Corrected magnitude: 6h should be moderate/strong for immediate-early genes; 24h weak for direct targets.
Corrected line_response: all lines set to weak is unsupported; expected differences by receptor/kinase expression and driver mutations.
